india.one_line: Anthropic's Nasdaq debut drew heavy Indian retail trading, Google funded IIT Kharagpur AI research, and SatSure raised Series B funding.

themes.title: Anthropic debut drives Indian retail investment
themes.text: Anthropic's Nasdaq debut drove heavy trading activity among Indian retail investors across overseas platforms including INDmoney, Mudrex, and Vested, accounting for significant portions of international investment activity and traded value.

stories.headline: Anthropic Nasdaq debut sparks buying rush among Indian retail investors

themes.title: Google funds IIT Kharagpur AI research
themes.text: Google committed $5 million to IIT Kharagpur to support advanced AI research across Indic languages, materials science, agriculture, and educational technology.

stories.headline: Google announces $5M funding for IIT Kharagpur for advanced AI research

themes.title: SatSure raises funding for geospatial AI
themes.text: Earth-intelligence startup SatSure raised ₹60 Cr from the Antariksh Venture Capital Fund to advance optical payloads, scale its geospatial AI model Dhaarini, and expand operations.

stories.headline: SatSure raises ₹60 Cr from Antariksh VC fund in Series B round
